what: M1 amendment 01: density-normalised scores, fixed before the held-out benchmark is read for them

density.fusion: each matcher normalised by its own density; fused score = mean of the normalised scores

benchmark: the held-out images and clusters of protocol.json, unchanged
adoption: protocol.json's rule against the baseline; the fused candidate must also pass it against sscd_sn
chosen_on: training clusters only (pre-M1 links); evidence in amendment_01_development.json
tier_rule: thresholds T4, T5, T6 = the matcher's score at FMR 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6 on the held-out benchmark; confirmed: (score >= T5 and SIFT RANSAC inliers on the originals >= 30) or (score >= T6 and inliers >= 12); at_risk (if not confirmed): score >= T6, or (score >= T5 and inliers >= 8), or (score >= T4 and inliers >= 12); a matcher without T4/T6 (scored before amendment 01): at_risk score >= T5, confirmed also inliers >= 30
